# Pull requests are not accepted

This repository is the public home of a **closed-source product**: documentation, releases, signatures, and issues. There is no source code here to patch.

- Found a bug? Open an [issue](../../issues) with the bug template.
- Have a capability in mind? Open a [feature request](../../issues) with the feature template.
- Security? Follow [SECURITY.md](../../blob/main/SECURITY.md) — encrypt to PGP, never in a public issue.

A PR against this repo will be closed with a pointer to this file. This is not rejection of your work — it is the shape of the product.
